GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok , sat back in second half 3 Wide 6 Lengths 800m, came widest from the corner, battled on well at the one pace to be just out of placings # battled on well

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Slow out 1 length and Settled Down 4 Lengths on fence, Drifted Back to 7.5 Lengths rail turning, railed up rounding turn, got the inside run Straightening Up and kept coming along fence in Straight # never left fence
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Slow to begin. Steadied from heels near the 900m when the pace slackened.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Bit Slow Out Not Bustled Settled Down rear 12 Lengths held together well back to straightening up = imposs task, Kept Trying Closest on line forgive, # sat too far back

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Made no use of the rails gate settled down four back 7 Lengths (1000m), closer 600, cornered off Inside about to gain a clear run, made Ground Without threat # worked home late

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Squeezed at the start settled down worse Mid Field Two Wide 6-7 Lengths (1000m), 3 Wide 600, Four Wide Soon After improving quickly, 5 deep for home Under Whip Soon After , couldn't run on (Hanoverian Nose Band FIRST TIME, Nose Roll OFF AGAIN) # Wide from 600/sound
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Tightened at the start between runners.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Bit Slow Out .5 Lengths Settled Down last 1200m 4th 4 Lengths 1000m Went Forward Outside Leader 2 Lengths home turn 2nd 3 Lengths Hard Ridden Straightened Up 2nd Under Pressure tired final 200m # fair effort
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Raced wide and without cover until near the 1100m.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped okay, Eased & Settled Down last 11 Lengths Two Wide , checked 700m, Moved Up to 9 Lengths rail turning, shifted off fence 375m, Made Ground through field, blocked 200m, shifted in looking for a run, Made Ground to the line. [Stewards questioned rider re tactics adopted.] # needed more luck
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Improved onto heels near the 700m & checked. When questioned re tactics, Rdr reported after improving onto heels was then obliged to steady near the 700m-added approaching the 600m, was unable to improve wider and then obliged to look for runs nearer to the inside round home turn.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped only fairly & Settled Down 7 Lengths Two Wide , made no ground to Turn then Hooked Out to 7 Lengths 3 Wide , shifted wider Straightening Up and Made Ground in Straight # battled on ok

Jumped ok Wide out went back looking to slot in couldn't ended up 3 Wide no cover 4 Lengths (1000m), went on with it to lead Inside 800, cross & clear the field 600, urged for home soon headed & faded out of it, entitled to # worked too hard
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Raced wide early before being ridden forward from the 900m to take up a leading position.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped okay, Eased & Settled Down 9 Lengths 2-3 wide, Drifted Back to 11 Lengths Two Wide turning, hooked wider rounding turn and Made Some Ground in Straight # never a real threat
Hampered 1 length on jumping and Settled Down 7 Lengths Two Wide , made no ground to Turn then Hooked Out Straightening Up and Made Some Ground in Straight # hampered at start

Jumped okay, a length slow into stride and Settled Down 8 Lengths Two Wide , Made Some Ground to 6 Lengths Two Wide turning, in some traffic early in straight, shifted wider inside the furlong and kept coming, hit Lead 20m from post. [Stewards: Raced keenly early/middle stages. Raced ungenerously 800m.] # ran on well
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Slow into stride. Raced keenly in the early and middle stages. Raced ungenerously approaching the 800m. Had some difficulty obtaining clear running in the early stages of the home straight. Laid in under pressure in the home straight.
